diagnosis_candidates.description: The application.yml configures storage.max-entries to 0. However, the StorageProperties class enforces a @Min(1) constraint on the maxEntries field. Because the class is annotated with @Validated, Spring Boot's property binding fails during startup, throwing a BindException.
diagnosis_candidates.recommended_fix: Update the storage.max-entries value in application.yml to be between 1 and 5000, or adjust the @Min constraint in StorageProperties.java if 0 is intended to be a valid capacity.
